literal_meaning: টেনে নেওয়ার শব্দময় ভঙ্গি বা অনুকরণ
figurative_meaning_en: The manner of dragging or pulling along reluctantly
example_sentences_in_english: He went to school dragging his feet.
The child ate his food dragging it out.
note: This idiom is onomatopoeic, mimicking the sound of reluctant dragging, common in rural and everyday Bengali speech.
